literal: Greatness is the absence of self-importance; pettiness is riding on self-importance.
translation: Greatness is characterized by the absence of self-importance; pettiness is marked by riding high on pride.
modern: பெருமை என்பது அகந்தை இல்லாமல் இருப்பது ஆகும்; சிறுமை என்பது அகந்தையைத் தலைமேல் ஏற்றி வைத்துக் கொண்டு ஆடுவது ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts true greatness with pettiness. Greatness is defined not by power or wealth, but by the complete absence of self-importance or arrogance ('perumitam'). Conversely, pettiness is marked by riding upon pride, letting arrogance drive one's actions. The verb 'ūrntu' (riding or mounting) vividly illustrates how petty minds are carried away by their own inflated self-worth.
